boundary: Capture a known static subset of project instructions. Keep the original hierarchy and read triggers; vendor runtime flags, environment, managed policy and Shell activity are not reproduced. Migration does not grant permissions or enable imported context.
sourceRoot: Authorized source root on the selected source device
authority: Both locations must already be trusted by that source account. The starting directory must be inside the selected root. A product directory selection does not authorize project parents.
descendants: Include known instruction files in child directories
staticConsent: I confirm this static subset and authorize reading the selected root and starting directory.
login: Sign in to both selected accounts before migration.
updateRequired: This source or target needs an updated instruction migration capability.
failed: The original instruction operation could not be confirmed. Read its saved state before continuing.
unknown: Capture result is unknown. Read the original capture; do not create a replacement request.
empty: No known instruction file was captured.
transferConsent: Transfer this captured instruction graph, including its fixed dependencies. Target scope and publication will be confirmed separately.
previewBoundary: Read-only preview; imported context remains disabled.
binary: Opaque bytes are shown as Base64; they are not executable text.
releasePending: Source cleanup is not confirmed. Keep the original operation reference.
mappingBoundary: Choose each item and an existing directory relative to the target workspace. Source paths do not authorize target locations. Saving keeps imported instructions disabled.
targetScope: Target relative directory (empty means workspace root)
mapConsent: I confirm these target directories and the supported static subset.
archiveIncomplete: Keep unsupported or incomplete originals as disabled pending assets. This does not enable an unknown instruction chain.
mappingConfirmed: Scope mapping is confirmed for this original receipt.
unsupported: This legacy or opaque item has no verified scoped interpretation. Its original migration state is preserved.
